objects: One circuit with a lower rectangular return wire.
One lamp, drawn as a circle containing two crossing diagonal strokes, on the upper-right part of the lower circuit.
One capacitor on the right vertical side, drawn as two short thick horizontal plates separated by a gap.

The two lower switch contacts connect respectively to the lamp/capacitor path and to the lower return path.
